scientific.integrity: The source SlowMo equations are reduced exactly on a scalar quadratic to a second-order outer recurrence. The complete second-order Jury criterion yields a necessary-and-sufficient stability condition, from which the local-step parity law follows algebraically.
limitations: Parity formula specializes to slow learning rate alpha equal to one; the general stability inequality is also stated.
Outer-state stability can coexist with expansive intermediate fast iterates.
No stochastic-noise, worker-heterogeneity, or generalization claim.

title: SlowMo has an exact local-step parity stability law
